snippet.title: Aliens Versus Predator 2 (2001) PCVR Mod
snippet.description:
After doing the first Aliens Versus Predator port the most common question was "Do AvP 2!". So here it is, v0.1 release!

Find details at: github.com/Bassquake/Aliens-Versus-Predator-2-VR

This is PCVR only as there's no true source code of the game. Use Steam Link as Meta Link doesn't work with 32 bit games.

Have fun!

AvP 1 VR: github.com/Bassquake/Aliens-Versus-Predator-VR
AvP 2 VR: github.com/Bassquake/Aliens-Versus-Predator-2-VR

v0.2 has been released. Check the github. (2/10/26)

v0.3 has been released. Check the github. (13/10/26)
